deviations.php: Strings that leave fields unset take them from the current time (gettimeofday).
deviations.reason: php_std::datetime::DateTime::parse takes 'now' as an argument (DateTime::new reads the clock). The compat operations construct only from strings that do not depend on now; relative formats are checked through strtotime() with a base timestamp and modify() of a fixed date.
Functions take the default zone as an argument (TzInfo::utc() for Appwrite); there is no global.
